findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "energy-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: energy-intelligence_regional · Private data: contact_us · Public sink: contact_us.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: energy-intelligence_regional · Private data: contact_us · Public sink: contact_us

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
